newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower Press sells $250 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower Press sells $250 mln in notes.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Big Flower Press Inc priced on Thursday via BT Securities Corp, Credit Suisse First Boston and Goldman Sachs & Co, according to a source close to the deal.
The company said it will tender for its $126.7 million outstanding 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 upon completion of Tuesday's offering.
